explanation: Materialize the complete inorder sequence recursively, then return its zero-based entry k-1. A strict BST visits keys in increasing inorder order, making this the kth smallest value.
timeComplexity: O(n²) worst-case time for recursive inorder list concatenation/copying, followed by O(1) indexed selection.
spaceComplexity: O(n + h) materialized values and recursion for n nodes and height h.
attribution: Original repository-authored Blind75 Java algorithm, promoted from the validated correct fixtures. Collection membership follows Crackr; no external solution service is used.
